high_level_description: This image depicts an urban street scene with a focus on two black and yellow bollards positioned on either side of a white pillar. The bollards appear to be made of rubber or a similar flexible material, designed to protect the pillar from vehicle impacts. The pillar itself is plain white and stands against a wall that has some visible wear and tear, including cracks and discoloration. The background includes a section of a sidewalk and part of a building with a dark-colored wall and what appears to be a green plant or shrub growing out of a planter box.
